# render-contributions

Contributes a `Contributions.FacetTable` tab to the Studio Contributions view showing all
resources aggregated across plugins, one row per served resource (a `serveValue`
/ `serveCollection` mint, or a direct `defineResource`) with key, mode, runtime
(server/central), and owning plugin columns. Reads
`node.facets["resources"]` for every plugin.
